title: Praise To The Lord, The Almighty
lyrics: [G]Praise to the Lord, the Al[D]mighty, the [C]King of cre[D]ati[G]on.
[G]O my soul praise Him, for [D]He is thy [C]health and sal[D]va[G]tion.
[G]Praise to the Lord who o'er [D]all things so [C]wondrously [D]reig[G]neth.
[G]Shelters thee under His [D]wings, yea, so [C]gently su[D]stai[G]neth
[G]Hast thou not [C]seen [Em]how thy de[C]sires e're have [D]been
[G]Praise to the Lord, who doth [D]prosper thy [C]work and de[D]fend [G]thee.
[G]Praise to the Lord, o let [D]all that is [C]in me a[D]dore [G]Him.
[G]All that hath life and breath, [D]come now with [C]praises be[D]fore [G]Him.
artist: from Ander Theil des Erneuerten Gesangbuch, Neander, Joachim (1650-1680)
